items.question: Is this a generic AI video generator?
items.answer: No. The current product is intentionally narrow: GitHub release data goes through deterministic brand-safe templates so repeated releases stay visually consistent.

items.question: Do I need a private-repository token?
items.answer: Not for the current early-access flow. The MVP starts with public GitHub repositories so we can validate the workflow without asking for repository credentials.

items.question: What do I get during the pilot?
items.answer: We take one real release, configure the brand treatment and produce short-form release assets while measuring how much manual work the workflow removes.
